channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Free Museum Days In 2026: The Adler, Art Institute, Shedd And More
item.description: Explore cultural hubs like the Swedish American Museum and Museum of Mexican Art or visit landmarks like the Art Institute of Chicago and DuSable Black History Museum.

item.title: Beverly Area Planning Association Begins Search For New Executive Director
item.description: Mary Jo Viero, longtime executive director of the civic organization, retired at the end of 2025 after a decade of service.

item.title: Don’t Miss These 5 Shows At Chicago Theaters This January
item.description: Plays by teens, an interactive show for babies and fictionalized biographies all come to Chicago stages this month.

item.title: Mexican Bakeries Ready For Three Kings Day After Sales Dip Amid Operation Midway Blitz
item.description: Bakeries in Pilsen and Little Village have been busy preparing hundreds of wreath-shaped breads called Rosca de Reyes for Tuesday’s holiday, upholding a beloved tradition for Latino families.

item.title: Edgewater Indoor Market Returning To Broadway Armory This Winter
item.description: Neighbors will be able to shop from more than 70 local vendors at the indoor market. The first market is Saturday, with four others taking place throughout the winter.

item.title: Your Uber Will Cost More In These Zones Starting Now — And Other New Fees You Should Know About
item.description: The new "congestion” zones in the 2026 city budget mean some Uber and Lyft users will pay an extra $1.50 fee per ride. Shopping bags now cost 15 cents, a 5-cent hike from last year.

item.title: Obama Center Now Hiring For 150 Full-Time Jobs
item.description: The Obama Foundation is hiring "people who will keep this place safe and welcoming" in fields like guest services, facility management and security, former President Barack Obama said.

item.title: It Could Hit 50 Degrees This Week In Chicago
item.description: The warmup will be brief, with temperatures dropping back down to the low 30s by Saturday.

item.title: Black-Owned Brewery, Little Village Visitor Center Among 58 Projects Getting $33 Million From City
item.description: A content production studio in East Garfield Park and additional Rogers Park classrooms for youth with autism were also awarded city grant funding Tuesday.

item.title: Barnes & Noble To Open Largest Chicago Store Downtown This Summer
item.description: The 30,000-square-foot store will take over the former Old Navy space on State Street, which has been vacant since 2023 and was years ago the flagship location of rival bookseller Borders.
